plan.fit_summary: Strong fit: DACHSER operates European Logistics, Air & Sea Logistics and Food Logistics segments from its headquarters in Kempten [2], and its Food Logistics business continues to expand [5], matching ColdTrace's temperature-controlled logistics focus.

who.why: Owns the segment that DACHSER says continues to expand [5], where temperature monitoring and audit trails are core to the service.
DACHSER lists Quality Management among its services [8] and operates a compliance reporting system [3], so this role owns audit and documentation processes.

plan.hook: DACHSER's own reporting states that Food Logistics continues to expand [5]. As that network grows, so does the temperature documentation owed to customers and auditors — ColdTrace automates exactly that with wireless sensors and automatic audit reports.
plan.channel: Phone call first: DACHSER is headquartered in Kempten, Germany [2], and German law (UWG § 7) requires prior consent for cold email, also in B2B. Call with a concrete business reason — reducing manual temperature documentation in the expanding Food Logistics segment [5] — or send a LinkedIn message to the role. The email draft is for use only after consent or as a physical letter. Not legal advice.
avoid: Do not name or guess any individual — address roles only.
Do not claim DACHSER has temperature-monitoring gaps or compliance problems; no source supports that.
Do not cite figures from the Yahoo articles [4][7]; their page content did not load and cannot be verified.
questions: How is temperature data currently captured and turned into audit reports across your Food Logistics transport and warehouse operations, and how much of that process is still manual?

draft.body:
Ihr eigenes Mediaroom berichtet, dass Ihr Food-Lokistik-Geschäft weiter wächst [5]. Mit jedem zusätzlichen Transport und Standort steigt der Aufwand, Temperaturdaten für Kunden und Prüfer lückenlos zu dokumentieren. Wir automatisieren genau diese Dokumentation mit drahtlosen Sensoren und selbst erstellten Prüfberichten. Ist das für Sie gerade ein Thema?
